properties.name: parentId
properties.description: Filter, used to query process instances that have a specific parent process instance.

properties.name: rootId
properties.description: Filter, used to query process instances descending from a root process instance, which itself is included in the query results.

properties.name: tags
properties.description: Tags, a process instance must have, to be included.

items.description: Tag is used to tag processes, process instances and user tasks.

properties.name: offset
properties.description: The number of results to skip, before returning any result. If offset is 0, no results are skipped.

properties.name: limit
properties.description: Maximum number of results to return. If limit is 0, all results are returned.
